_comment: Film 68 Lyria 3.5 prompts (google/lyria-3.5, 6 tracks, 2026-11-24). One track per chapter: M0 = H,1 | M1 = R1,R2 | M2 = R3,R4 | M3 = M,5 | M4 = 6 | M5 = 9,A2 + end screen. Prompt sent = style + ' A <len> track. ' + mood. Files in /tmp/claude-0/f68/audio/music, not in the repo.
style: Instrumental underscore for a calm, thoughtful editorial documentary about the race between America and China to build superintelligent AI. Mystical and quietly tense, not triumphant: an empty stadium at night under floodlights, a giant glowing scoreboard, a dark third lane waiting. Slowly unfolding arpeggios on soft felt piano and celesta, shimmering glassy pads, warm low drones, soft bowed strings, a faint distant pulse like footsteps far away. No drums, no percussion kit, no beat, no vocals, no choir, no melody hook, not pop, not uplifting, not epic, not sports anthem, not cinematic trailer. Very quiet, narrow dynamic range, slow, made to sit under a speaking voice.

M0.chapter: H, 1 (the race decided by 2027, the scoreboard 2:2, the dark third lane; the forecast, the moment AI does AI research)
M0.mood: mysterious and expectant: a circling celesta arpeggio like a question, a low warm drone, faint glass shimmer; standing alone in a vast night stadium before a race; steady and calm, no build-up

M1.chapter: R1, R2 (round 1 the machines, Schmidt clip; round 2 the chips, America 2:0)
M1.mood: precise and analytical: patient repeating plucked notes like a scoreboard counting, soft piano, airy pads, a very faint steady low pulse without drums; curious and measured

M2.chapter: R3, R4 (round 3 power, round 4 open models and humanoid robots; the board is level)
M2.mood: deeper and wider: slow sustained low strings, a warm drone like distant power lines humming, sparse piano notes, a hint of motion in the middle; mystical, slightly uneasy, no thriller

M3.chapter: M, 5 (subscribe call; the finish line, the report, the essay; the third lane lights up, the trap)
M3.mood: warm and human at first, then mystical and tense: a cold glassy shimmer slowly rises, hovering unresolved harmonies, a soft heartbeat-like low pulse; awe with growing unease, never loud

M4.chapter: 6 (a way out of the trap, a speed limit, different races, the rivals start to talk, a human in the loop)
M4.mood: searching and tentative: soft felt piano and low strings, harmonies that slowly loosen and open, a fragile thread of hope at the end; sober, no drama

M5.chapter: 9, A2 + end screen (who wins; roads still open; everyone crosses together; closing call)
M5.mood: calm and gently hopeful, still mystical: the circling celesta arpeggio returns slower, warm felt piano over soft strings, open and human, not triumphant; ends on one long decaying warm chord
